retainedZeroUpdateMemoryStops.diagnosis: Both complete exact model load proofs exist before the RAM stop. The original worker never published a largest-query-preflight stage; the displayed loading state is stale. trainingProtocol.referenceUse: Supervised official TRAIN samples only. True transcripts/activity enter losses, never deployment inputs. Existing benchmark/finalholdout excluded.
trainingProtocol.architecture: Exact complete PS4 base plus zero-initialized per-band spatial projection of interchannel cosIPD/sinIPD/loglevel. Full separation backbone/mask trainable, speaker encoder and ASR teacher frozen. Mono path supported.
trainingProtocol.preparationStop: No optimizer step until feature parity, independent finite differences, native CE label-shift parity, base zero-adapter exact-output parity and nonzero finite target/separation/spatial gradients all pass. A failed graph is a preparation failure, not a model score.
trainingProtocol.preparationCorrection: Only synthetic numeric FD device corrected: old CPU OpenBLAS aborted under guarded runtime. Same data, objectives, tolerances, model weights and zero-update boundary. Reuse existing validated GPU path, no CPU allocation workaround.
trainingProtocol.optimizer: AdamW, allactualseparationbackbone+zero spatial projections; speaker encoder and recognizer frozen.
trainingProtocol.loss: Present target: frozenrecognizer target-token CE plus normalized annotated noisy waveform preservation/absence loss. Fully absent target: exact-zero waveform loss only, no dependence on a recognizer forced-Chinese blank-token preference. Overlap waveform supervision only outside target annotation; no fabricated clean overlap waveform.
trainingProtocol.qualityDecision: Before/after48heldout TRAIN-source validation inputs, supervised profiles. No gradient updates using validation. Advance to freeASR only if both present-category CE nonregress, absence meanRMS strictlylower and maxRMS nonregress, solo waveform preservation nonregress. This proxy gate cannot qualify a model. Free generations and automatic-meeting profiles remain necessary before any deployment. No LR/epoch sweep or best-epoch selection.
trainingProtocol.scope: One pilot training pass, not generalized/production qualification. Two training sessions and one validation session; physical speaker overlap unknown. Final holdout unopened; product defaults unchanged.
trainingProtocol.memoryCorrection: Only residual-RNN intermediate activations are recomputed during backward. Complete pinned weights, all data/labels, one-pass order, optimizer and learning rates remain identical. Phase/GPU/physical-RAM telemetry added. Output and all 562 trainable parameter gradient groups compared before this trial.

next: 完成固定166组单遍训练及48组分开会议验证；全骨干＋空间分支训练，声纹编码器和识别器冻结。仅在预定验证非回退条件通过后做无参考自由转写，不能以训练损失或梯度通过冒充可用；原完整会议<5%、事实、双端实卡和售卖门保留。
